row.evidence: Broadcom's VCF Salt docs list native, SAML, OAuth/OIDC and LDAP/Active Directory authentication, with SAML users "added as a user in the local user database" only after first login; no SCIM provisioning is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. saltstack.com now redirects to saltproject.io (open-source Salt, © Broadcom); the commercial product is VMware Salt / VCF Salt (formerly SaltStack Enterprise / Tanzu Salt), self-hosted RaaS documented on techdocs.broadcom.com. The old Tanzu Salt product URL redirects to VMware Advanced Cyber Compliance, which has no public price (Contact Sales); add-ons such as Compliance and Vulnerability need separate licences. SSO via SAML, OAuth/OIDC (Okta documented) with JIT registration on first login; LDAP/AD sync with background deactivation. The RaaS API can manage user accounts but its reference is not yet published.

scim.notes: By absence (rule 5): VCF Salt's documented user sources are native accounts, SAML, OAuth/OIDC and LDAP/AD; no SCIM page appears among ~2,600 Salt URLs in Broadcom's techdocs sitemaps. SAML/OIDC users are registered on first login; LDAP users are linked and checked by a periodic background job.

capabilities.notes: Docs say users cannot be deleted via UI or API after their first SAML login; other capabilities not documented publicly.

limitations.text: Users provisioned through a successful SAML login cannot be deleted via the UI or API.

user_api.notes: The RaaS (eAPI) server exposes an API that can do anything the web UI does, including managing user accounts, but the full API reference is not yet published ('will be published soon'). Self-hosted product: the API is on the customer's own RaaS server.

okta.notes: No OIN app found (okta.com/integrations/saltstack and saltstack-enterprise 404); VCF Salt's own SAML and OIDC guides cover Okta as IdP. No provisioning.

entra.notes: Learn tutorial saltstack-tutorial 404; the SAML guide only mentions Azure AD/ADFS terminology.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory directory service connection: linked groups and users, checked by a periodic background job that deactivates removed entries
fallbacks.notes: Whether OIDC sign-in also creates users on first login is not stated.
